name: Paletas El Sol
facts: Paletas El Sol is a sample ice cream truck with live truck alerts in its app.
Join with your first name and get 10 free points.
Turn on truck alerts and the app rings your phone when the truck is close.
Check in at the truck by scanning the QR on it, once per truck visit.
5 visits = a treat on us: 10% off or an extra scoop free.
Alerts on = +5 bonus points every visit.
Rewards: 50¢ off (30 pts), $1 off (50 pts), free chili cheese Fritos (80 pts), free paleta (100 pts).
Quiet after 8 PM can be turned on in Settings.
Your house pin is saved only on your phone.
The app is in English and Español.
Menu: paletas, ice cream bars, raspados, chili cheese Fritos, elote en vaso, elote on the cob.
suggested: How do I get the app on my iPhone?

qa.q: What is this app?
qa.a: It's the Paletas El Sol truck app. It shows the truck on a live map, tells you when it's close, and lets you collect points and rewards.

qa.q: How do I join?
qa.a: Type your first name and tap "Join + get 10 free points." It takes about 10 seconds.

qa.q: Do I get anything for joining?
qa.a: Yes, you get 10 free points when you join.

qa.q: Do I need to give my full name?
qa.a: No, the app only asks for your first name.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: Joining is free, and you get 10 free points.

qa.q: How do truck alerts work?
qa.a: The app rings your phone when the truck is close to your street. You get one alert per truck visit.

qa.q: How do I see where the truck is?
qa.a: Open the app and look at the live map at the top. It shows your house pin and the truck driving toward you.

qa.q: How do I know when the truck will get to me?
qa.a: The app shows a countdown like "Arriving in ~10 min" along with how many miles away the truck is.

qa.q: What do the truck status messages mean?
qa.a: The app tells you if the truck is on the way, stopped to sell, almost here, on your street, or has left.

qa.q: How fast does the truck drive?
qa.a: The truck drives at about 10 mph. It stops to sell every few blocks, and sits on your street for about a minute and a half.

qa.q: What's the ice cream blimp on the map?
qa.a: It's a little ice cream sign above the truck. It gets more scoops as the truck gets closer, and melts when the truck leaves your area.

qa.q: What does the "I'm coming!" button do?
qa.a: When the alert rings, tapping "I'm coming!" lets the driver see that 1 person is on the way.

qa.q: How do I stop the alert sound?
qa.a: Tap "Silence" on the alert.

qa.q: Can I test the alert?
qa.a: Yes, tap "Test the alert" to hear the jingle that rings when the truck is close.

qa.q: What is the jingle?
qa.a: It's the music-box tune that plays when the truck is near. You can turn it off in Settings with "Play the jingle."

qa.q: How do I tell the app which street I'm on?
qa.a: Tap "Allow location" or "Type my street" and enter your street and city. The app uses it to know which street to ring.

qa.q: Do you follow my location?
qa.a: No. Your location is only used to know which street to ring when the truck is close, and you can turn it off any time.

qa.q: Does the truck see my address?
qa.a: No. Your house pin is saved only on your phone, and the truck never sees your address.

qa.q: What if the street I typed isn't found?
qa.a: The app will say it couldn't find that street, and the map keeps showing your last pin. Try typing the street and city again.

qa.q: How do I turn on alerts on iPhone?
qa.a: Tap Share (the square with the arrow), then Add to Home Screen. Open the app from your Home Screen and allow notifications. That's Apple's rule for alerts.

qa.q: How do I turn on alerts on Android?
qa.a: Just tap "Allow" when the app asks.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my home screen?
qa.a: On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open it from there. On Android, just tap "Allow" when asked about alerts.

qa.q: How far away will the truck ring me?
qa.a: You choose in Settings: when the truck is within 0.15, 0.25 or 0.5 miles.

qa.q: Can I turn alerts off?
qa.a: Yes. Switch "Alerts on" off in Settings any time. Note you'd miss the +5 bonus points per visit.

qa.q: Can I stop alerts at night?
qa.a: Yes, there's a "Quiet after 8 PM" switch in Settings.

qa.q: How many alerts will I get?
qa.a: One alert per truck visit.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You get 10 free points when you join, and +5 bonus points every visit if your truck alerts are on. The driver also scans your code at the window when you buy.

qa.q: How many points do I get per purchase?
qa.a: The app's demo adds 10 points per purchase. For the exact amount on the real truck, ask the driver.

qa.q: Is there a points-per-dollar ratio?
qa.a: The app doesn't show a per-dollar ratio. It shows 10 points per purchase in the demo, so ask the driver for the real truck's rate.

qa.q: What are the alert bonus points?
qa.a: If you keep truck alerts on, you get +5 bonus points every visit.

qa.q: How do I earn points when I buy something?
qa.a: At the window, the driver scans your code in the app. Open the Points section to show it.

qa.q: Where do I see my points?
qa.a: In the "Points + rewards" section of the app, which shows your total and how far you are from the next reward.

qa.q: What rewards can I get?
qa.a: 50¢ off (30 pts), $1 off (50 pts), free chili cheese Fritos (80 pts), and a free paleta (100 pts).

qa.q: How many points for 50¢ off?
qa.a: 50¢ off costs 30 points.

qa.q: How many points for $1 off?
qa.a: $1 off costs 50 points.

qa.q: How many points for free chili cheese Fritos?
qa.a: Free chili cheese Fritos cost 80 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free paleta?
qa.a: A free paleta costs 100 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap "Use" next to the reward once you have enough points. You'll get a code to show the driver.

qa.q: Why is the Use button grayed out?
qa.a: You don't have enough points for that reward yet. The app shows how many more points you need for the next one.

qa.q: Do my points get used up when I redeem?
qa.a: Yes, redeeming a reward takes its point cost off your total.

qa.q: What is the visit card?
qa.a: It's a 5-visit card. Check in on 5 visits and you get a treat on us.

qa.q: What do I get on my 5th visit?
qa.a: You pick a treat: 10% off or an extra scoop free.

qa.q: How do I check in at the truck?
qa.a: Scan the QR code on the truck. You can check in once per truck visit.

qa.q: Can I check in more than once per visit?
qa.a: No, it's one check-in per truck visit.

qa.q: What happens to my visit card after I pick a treat?
qa.a: Your card starts over from zero.

qa.q: How do I use my treat?
qa.a: After picking it, show the code to the driver.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Paletas, ice cream bars, raspados, chili cheese Fritos, elote en vaso, and elote on the cob.

qa.q: What flavors do the paletas come in?
qa.a: Strawberry, mango con chile, lime and coconut.

qa.q: What ice cream bars do you have?
qa.a: Cookies & cream, strawberry shortcake and chocolate.

qa.q: What are raspados?
qa.a: Shaved ice in tamarind, mango or strawberry.

qa.q: What are the chili cheese Fritos?
qa.a: Fritos with warm chili and nacho cheese.

qa.q: What is elote en vaso?
qa.a: Corn in a cup with mayo, cheese, chile and lime.

qa.q: What is elote on the cob?
qa.a: It has the same toppings as the cup, but on a stick.

qa.q: How much do things cost?
qa.a: The app shows sample prices: paletas $2.50, ice cream bars $3.00, raspados $4.00, chili cheese Fritos $5.00, elote en vaso $5.00, elote on the cob $4.50. The real truck sets its own, so check with the driver.

qa.q: Can I order ahead in the app?
qa.a: The app doesn't have ordering or payment. You buy from the driver at the truck window.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: The app doesn't take payments. Ask the driver at the window how they accept payment.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: I don't have hours listed. The truck follows a route, so watch the live map or ask staff.

qa.q: What's the truck's phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number for the truck. Ask the driver at the window.

qa.q: Where is the truck located?
qa.a: It drives a route, so there's no fixed address. Check the live map to see where it is.

qa.q: Where can I park?
qa.a: I don't have any parking info, since the truck comes to your street. Ask the driver if you need help.

qa.q: Are there games in the app?
qa.a: There are no games in this app. It has truck alerts, points, a visit card and a menu.

qa.q: Is there a weekly contest or leaderboard?
qa.a: No, there are no contests or leaderboards in this app.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club or referral bonus?
qa.a: I don't see a birthday club or referral bonus in the app. Ask the driver about special deals.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: No, the app has points, rewards and the 5-visit card. There are no levels or tiers.

qa.q: Is there a happy hour or daily special?
qa.a: I don't have any happy hour or specials listed. Ask the driver what's available today.

qa.q: Is the app available in Spanish?
qa.a: Yes, you can switch between English and Español.

qa.q: Is there a kids mode?
qa.a: The app doesn't have a kids mode.

qa.q: Is my info sold?
qa.a: No, your info is never sold.

qa.q: How do I delete my info?
qa.a: Tap "Leave + delete my info" in Settings.

qa.q: Can I change my settings later?
qa.a: Yes. In Settings you can change your ring distance, alerts, jingle and quiet hours.

qa.q: The map isn't loading. What should I do?
qa.a: The arrival time still works even if the map doesn't load. If routing is down, the path may look approximate.

qa.q: I didn't get an alert. Why?
qa.a: Check that "Alerts on" is on in Settings, you allowed notifications, and it's not after 8 PM if Quiet is on. On iPhone, open the app from your Home Screen.

qa.q: How can I talk to someone for help?
qa.a: I don't have a staff contact listed. Ask the driver at the truck window.

qa.q: Who makes this app?
qa.a: The app is made by SousShift AI.
